subject: cul-tf-s
title: CUL.TF.S.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-14 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the great predominance of information spread (or transfer) has been brought about through the destruction of nation against nation — what we call war' — that war-driven transfer brings 'special problems with respect to the reality underlying how information is viewed.' (C)CUL-TF-S (the concept of cultural transfer shifts) is crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics): the question is what cultural-transfer-shifts produces when crossed with social-reality-dynamics under war-mediated transfer conditions. C-INFO (composite information) branches from the main line and leads to AFL (affinity alignment), which carries MT-INFO (multi-information), with RT-DY (reality dynamics) on it, and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). TH-CONT carries CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) and (R)IST-F (the reality of isolated focus); from (R)IST-F run LANG-DY (language dynamics) and, by a *dashed* line, IST-F (isolated focus), and from LANG-DY a dashed line rises to S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation). A third dashed line runs from the main line to (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation). In Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to.
